events.title: Battle of the Little Bighorn Begins
events.description: Lakota, Northern Cheyenne, and Arapaho warriors led by leaders including Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse defeated the 7th Cavalry under Lt. Col. George Armstrong Custer in Montana Territory. Custer and over 200 of his men were killed in the engagement, which began on June 25 and continued into June 26.
events.significance: It was the most famous victory of Plains Indian forces over the U.S. Army, but it intensified the government's military campaign, leading to the defeat of the Lakota and the seizure of the Black Hills.

events.title: Korean War Begins
events.description: North Korean forces crossed the 38th parallel and invaded South Korea in the early hours of June 25, 1950. The United Nations Security Council responded by authorizing military assistance to South Korea, and the United States led a multinational force.
events.significance: The conflict became one of the first major proxy wars of the Cold War, involving the U.S., China, and the Soviet Union, and it left Korea divided to this day.

events.title: Croatia and Slovenia Declare Independence
events.description: Croatia and Slovenia formally declared independence from Yugoslavia, breaking away from the federation. Slovenia's declaration was followed by a brief Ten-Day War with the Yugoslav People's Army.
events.significance: The declarations marked the start of the breakup of Yugoslavia and the beginning of the Yugoslav Wars, which reshaped the Balkans in the 1990s.

events.title: Mir Space Station Collision
events.description: An unmanned Progress M-34 cargo spacecraft collided with the Russian space station Mir during a docking test, puncturing the Spektr module and causing depressurization. The crew sealed off the damaged module to save the station.
events.significance: The accident was the most serious in-orbit collision up to that time and highlighted the risks of aging space infrastructure, shaping lessons for international cooperation on the International Space Station.

events.title: Death of Michael Jackson
events.description: Michael Jackson, the American singer known as the King of Pop, died in Los Angeles at age 50 from acute propofol intoxication. His death occurred as he prepared for a series of comeback concerts in London.
events.significance: Jackson was among the best-selling and most influential entertainers of all time, and his death prompted a worldwide outpouring of mourning and renewed attention to his musical legacy.
